title: Concept: JWT signature verification disabled in python — review required
description: In python, the JWT decode options disable signature verification. The token then becomes a self-asserted identity document: the subject, roles and tenant come from the attacker’s own payload and every downstream authorization decision inherits them. The mistake is easy to introduce while debugging an expired key and easy to miss in review because the token still parses.
applicability: python services that validate bearer tokens.
risk: Authentication bypass and privilege escalation; HIGH severity.
